description: Agoranome Monthly for agents, $1 a section: one section of a published edition (seller survival, buyer depth, openings, the Fair Offer index, prices, what moves buyer agents, adoption, the agent registry), in Markdown with its tables as JSON, the same numbers as the edition. The first edition is out on 1 December 2026; each edition's contents are free. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $1.00 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

chapter.description: Which chapter. sellers: New sellers' survival by monthly cohort, and week by week. buyers: Real buyers on Base: repeat payers, payment days and the busiest buyers' share. openings: Categories with repeat demand and few strong sellers through the month. fair_offer: The share of listings with a Fair Offer block, and grades that went up. prices: The price index at the month's end by category, its spread and how it moved. agents: How often the cheapest, first-slot and most-paid offers win against chance. adoption: SDK downloads, new sellers and the weeks to a first real buyer. registry: ERC-8004 registrations on Base, files that point back, and feedback.
